holdout.rule: Use these exact archived bytes. Never reconstruct the holdout from a later source snapshot. Retain eligible polls whose publication date and collection end date are no later than the cutoff.

outcome.template: The 2022 outcome template is reused unchanged.
outcome.shares: Use the official two-decimal percentages for S, M, SD, V, C, KD, L and MP. Compute OTHER as exactly 100 minus their sum in decimal arithmetic. Preserve this rounding in the report.
outcome.error: For every component, report the drawn mean minus the official percentage in percentage points.

intervals.inclusion: For each registered marginal interval, report whether lower <= official percentage <= upper.

outcome.seats: Report the national modified Sainte-Lague approximation of the drawn mean beside the official constituency allocation. Never merge, substitute or reconcile the two allocations.

methods.reason: This was the shipped method frozen before the holdout cutoff. Its score is the qualifying prospective result even if the result is unflattering.

identity.identityComposition: The estimator executes at implementationCommit. The model freeze and release protocol are separately pinned administrative artifacts from the shipped release record; their later revisions do not replace the estimator bytecode identity.

methods.reason: The revised method was registered on 2026-09-14, after the 2026-09-12 holdout cutoff. It cannot qualify retrospectively and its score must be labelled non-qualifying wherever it appears.
methods.parameterSelection: The midpoint_candidate parameters selected by the latest resolved active cutoff, 2021-10-05, in the frozen run-2 tuning evidence.

execution.rule: Run these commands once, in order, from the repository root after this registration commit is merged. Do not edit a command, input, parameter, seed, draw count or reporting rule after opening the official result.
commands: test ! -e docs/validation/2026-prospective-holdout/official-result.json && test ! -e docs/validation/2026-prospective-holdout/official-result.json.sha256 && test ! -e docs/validation/2026-prospective-holdout/shipped-result.json && test ! -e docs/validation/2026-prospective-holdout/revised-result.json && test ! -e /tmp/swedishpolls-245-shipped && test ! -e /tmp/swedishpolls-245-revised
git worktree remove --force /tmp/swedishpolls-245-shipped && git worktree remove --force /tmp/swedishpolls-245-revised
execution.capture: Record each exact command, exit status, wall time and complete console output. Archive the official result URL, retrieval time, bytes and SHA-256 with the result.
